description: An HR business partner must decide whether to restart collaboration between Elena and Marcus after a failed project handoff and finalize the working agreement that will govern their repair period.

shared_context.S1: A project handoff between Elena and Marcus went poorly, and they have stopped coordinating directly on current work.
shared_context.S2: Talia is responsible for deciding whether the collaboration should restart and for documenting any working agreement.
shared_context.S3: The project still requires information to move between Elena and Marcus each week.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal case-closing process, Talia hears from Elena and Marcus before documenting the agreed working terms.

PF1.text: Elena's workable boundary is that direct messages after 18:00 are not allowed; urgent requests after that time must go to the shared project channel so she can respond during her agreed working hours. She has not raised this boundary with Talia because she expected the mediation to focus only on the handoff dispute.

PF2.text: Marcus informally committed in a recent one-to-one with Elena to send a written handoff checklist at least 24 hours before each transfer and to hold one scheduled weekly coordination meeting. The commitment was never added to the case record.

acceptance_conditions: Collaboration must restart under a documented working agreement.
Direct messages to Elena after 18:00 must be prohibited.
Urgent after-hours requests must use the shared project channel.
Marcus must provide the written handoff checklist at least 24 hours before each transfer.
The agreement must require exactly one scheduled coordination meeting per week.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['written_handoff_checklist', 'handoff_checklist', 'handoff_process', 'handoff'] and c['target'] == 'Marcus' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Elena's stated boundary changes the agreement from ordinary direct messaging to a prohibition on after-18:00 direct messages and requires the shared project channel for urgent requests.
Marcus's prior commitment changes the handoff notice requirement to exactly 24 hours, sets exactly one weekly coordination meeting, and requires a written-handoff-checklist commitment naming Marcus.
